newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends at 1.0575 on higher dlr outflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends at 1.0575 on higher dlr outflows.

text.p: Brazil's real rose by just 0.05 percent to close at 1.0575 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market on continued heavy financial sales, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a deficit of around 200 million reais Wednesday.
Traders said one of the reasons for today's deficit was that the Brazilian government bought around $100 million to pay part of its external debt.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market and the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.0587 per greenback and 1.085 per dollar, respectively.
